newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Kabul arrests two men on uranium smuggling charge.
newsitem.headline: Kabul arrests two men on uranium smuggling charge.

text.p: Afghan authorities arrested two men in the capital Kabul on Saturday for trying to smuggle uranium out of the country, the official Kabul radio said.
The broadcast, monitored in Islamabad, said the arrests were made by the Interior Ministry of the Taleban Islamic movement, which controls more than two-thirds of the war-shattered country.
It named one of the arrested men as Mohammad Ehsan and said the case was under investigation. No further details were given.
